create_hashicorp_secret_manager: create a HashicorpSecretManager instance configured with Vault authentication credentials from environment variables
build_vault_url: build a Vault KV v2 API URL from secret name, namespace, mount name, and path prefix parameters
test_auth_via_approle: test authenticating to Hashicorp Vault using AppRole credentials with cached token support
read_secret_from_vault: read a secret value from Hashicorp Vault KV v2 using async or sync HTTPX client with in-memory caching
write_secret_to_vault: write a secret value to Hashicorp Vault KV v2 and return the response status and details
rotate_vault_secret: rotate a Vault secret by creating a new one with a new value, verifying it, and deleting the old secret
delete_vault_secret: delete a secret from Hashicorp Vault KV v2 and clear its cache entry
review_hashicorp_secret_manager: review the HashicorpSecretManager class and its methods for reading, writing, and rotating secrets in Vault
